Name: Cat Sounds to Frog Sounds
Author: doolan01
Description:
Extremely simple mod I made using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher from Pathoschild[/url]  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767?tab=description]Sound Tweaker by aedenthorn[/url] to accompany the froggies in[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16191] Otter's pet mod by Thatotterthing/Otterlyadorable.

[/url]Should randomize your frog to play 1 of 4 frog noises instead of meowing.
